scope: Static evidence and candidate admission protocol only. No hardware/register operations and no native control changes.

facts.fact: Read THERMINTST base+0xf04 and low8bits; each populated bank is dispatched if its summary bit is0.

Read bank+0x10 into w23, then write exactly w23 back to bank+0x10 and dsb sy. Corroborates BSP write-to-clear acknowledgement. Full status acknowledgement can consume completion flags owned by a concurrent observer.
Tests cold0, hot1/6/11 and SPM29/30/31. Does not interpret or consume TEMPMSR based on completion flags16..21 in this handler.

Reader chooses bank TEMPMSR at0x90/94/98 (and supported fourth0xb8), loads and masks0xfff; no completion-generation check. get_immediate_* wrapper names refer to cached converted values, not TEMPIMMD reads.
Initializes TEMPMSRCTL0 bank+0x38 to0x492, corresponding to BSP two-of-four filtering. A filtered value may lag an immediate sample.

Protection setup reads TEMPMONINT bank+0x0c, temporarily writes0, configures protection and restores oldmask|0x80000000. A freshness observer must not reproduce this disruptive setup or alter protection IRQ enables.

bsp_only_semantic_names.warning: Exact stock confirms status acknowledgement and filtered data path; bit-name-to-result-completion semantics remain BSP definitions, not independently exercised completion logic in stock.

candidate_masks.warning: Candidates for three/two active sensors respectively, not authorization to write.

admission_requirements: Exclusive per-bank completion-acknowledgement ownership shared with the real thermal IRQ handler; no independent stock-style full-status acknowledgement racing the observer. Preserve hot/cold/SPM handling and watchdog/direct-reset route.
Readback-validated initialized controller/ADC/sensor routing, clock and filter configuration; no pause/reset/reconfiguration by SSPM, firmware or another owner during measurement.

Independent proof that filtered status asserts on completion and denotes data visible in matching TEMPMSR, and whether status asserts with measurement interrupt enable clear. Do not enable measurement IRQs speculatively.

Only selected filtered W1C bits may be acknowledged using a literal mask; never read-modify-write the full status. Never write TEMPMONINT, protection registers, sensor pause bits, routing or clocks for freshness.

Observe selected filtered bits clear after acknowledgement with a bounded readback; reject preasserted/racing results if no low is observed. Require each corresponding bit subsequently high within the validated sampling bound.

After high and ordered reads, acquire corresponding TEMPMSR; reject timeout status, invalid raw/calibration, changed configuration or expired observation. Keep other protection status pending for its owner.
Treat the handshake as at least one post-clear filtered completion, not an exact generation counter. Do not infer freshness from raw change or equal repeated values.
Keep CPU fresh bits and dvfs_control_ready clear until these admission requirements and physical timing/ownership proof are satisfied.
not_proven: Status reassertion when measurement IRQ enable is0.
Precise completion/data visibility order and conversion latency under inherited filter/clock settings.
Physical transfer of IRQ acknowledgement ownership and preservation of independent protection.
A safe failure action/current budget for an actual performance governor.
